diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted series reaches ~0.42 by 6 h and remains stable through 18 h, consistent with a real plateau/carrying capacity rather than progressive hidden growth. The decisive check is the t=18 h 1:10 dilution in triplicate: readings 0.0396, 0.0492, 0.0400 (mean 0.0429), which back-correct to 0.429, essentially matching the undiluted t=18 reading 0.4199. The single 1:20 readings at 16–18 h back-correct higher (~0.50–0.62), but they are low-signal unreplicated reads and are internally inconsistent with the triplicate 1:10 result (a true OD ~0.58 should give ~0.058 at 1:10, not ~0.043). I therefore treat the 1:20 values as low-OD dilution/blank noise and conclude the late biomass is at the level indicated by the undiluted readings.
